definitions.explanation: A humble first-person plural pronoun used to refer to oneself and one's group, typically in business or formal settings when speaking to customers, superiors, or outsiders.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}{共|ども}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{任|まか}せ→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{私|わたし}{共|ども}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: At our company, we value quality.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}{共|ども}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不手際|ふてぎわ}→不手際：07598_futegiwa⟧で⟦ご{迷惑|めいわく}→ご迷惑：28069_gomeiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧おかけし、⟦{誠|まこと}→誠：27623_makoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません→申し訳ございません：18087_moushiwakegozaimasen⟧。
examples.english: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by our error.

notes:
A humble (⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧) first-person plural pronoun. The ど⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ suffix is a humble pluralizer that lowers the speaker's status relative to the listener. Very common in business Japanese.

FORMS:
⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧ (I) + {共|ども} (humble plural suffix). The suffix ど⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ can also attach to other words, but {私|わたし}{共|ども} is by far the most common combination.

USAGE:
Used when representing one's company, organization, or family to outsiders. Appropriate in formal correspondence, customer service, and business meetings. Not used in casual conversation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧: neutral "we" — standard and appropriate in most situations
- ⟦{我々|われわれ}→我々：03795_wareware⟧: "we" — formal and assertive, used in speeches and official statements
- ⟦{弊社|へいしゃ}→弊社：17404_heisha⟧: "our company" (humble) — specifically for one's own company, while {私|わたし}{共|ども} can refer to any in-group

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私|わたし}{共|ども}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: our shop (humble)
- {私|わたし}{共|ども}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: our products (humble)
- {私|わたし}{共|ども}としましては: from our standpoint (humble)
